newsitem.title: BELGIUM: City Hotels sees higher 1997 current loss.
newsitem.headline: City Hotels sees higher 1997 current loss.

text.p: Belgian hotels and airline group City Hotels said on Thursday it expected current earnings to slip further in 1997.
City Hotels had a 1996 current net loss of 19.3 million francs against a current net profit of 38.3 million in 1995.
"Globally, current results of the group should show a temporary decrease in 1997 pending the reconstruction of the group's hotel capacity in the United States," it said.
"However final results will be considerably higher than the average level of the previous years thanks to capital gains from the sale of the Doubletree and Hilton (hotels)," it said.
It said the sale of the Doubletree and Hilton in January yielded a pre-tax capital gain of $20 million of which 81 percent were earmarked for City Hotels.
